# Azure Functions Durable Graph

> Retired and unsupported as of 2026-10-02. No maintenance, fixes or security updates.
> `yeongseon` never published an official PyPI release of `azure-functions-durable-graph`.
> Do not treat a same-named PyPI project as official. Tags and GitHub releases are
> historical source snapshots. All linked guides and examples are historical.

Former experimental manifest-first runtime for Azure Durable Functions. There is
no current or planned official package installation. Documentation corrections do
not revive maintenance or authorize publishing; revival requires an explicit
maintainer decision and a dependency/Actions re-audit before re-enabling workflows.

## Getting Started
- [Installation](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/durable-graph/installation/): Retirement status and historical source inspection.
- [Quickstart](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/durable-graph/getting-started/): Minimal end-to-end example.
- [Configuration](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/durable-graph/configuration/): Configure the runtime.

## User Guide
- [Usage](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/durable-graph/usage/): Manifest and decorator reference.
- [Architecture](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/durable-graph/architecture/): How the graph runtime maps to Durable Functions.

## Examples
- [Data Pipeline](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/durable-graph/examples/data_pipeline/): ETL-style pipeline.
- [Content Classifier](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/durable-graph/examples/content_classifier/): Branching workflow.
- [Support Agent](https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/durable-graph/examples/support_agent/): Agentic workflow.
